Producer Technical Packet · Production Reference

Wild Ones production packet.

Controlled technical and operational reference for qualified producers. Verified facts are separated from field-verification items so this document does not overstate venue capabilities.

Open Interactive Map

Hawaiʻi Island Large-Format Production Grounds

Updated: September 2026 · Capacity target: 350 guests / ticket holders · Property: 4 acres

1. Venue positioning

Wild Ones is the large-format production identity for the Koa’s Events property, focused on concerts, EDM / dance events, festivals, retreats, production-company rentals, activations and substantial private productions.

2. Capacity model

Up to 350 guests or ticket holders is the current large-format planning target. Staff, performers, vendors and production crew are tracked separately and must be included in operational planning.

5. Required producer submissions

  1. Event overview and schedule.
  2. Site-plan / production footprint.
  3. Stage, audio, lighting and power requirements.
  4. Vendor list and production contacts.
  5. Security / guest-management plan.
  6. Insurance documentation as required.
  7. Special-effects requests and supporting safety documents.
  8. Load-in / load-out schedule and largest vehicle information.

6. Production timeline

Booked events should run through milestone tracking in the Wild Ones CRM: kickoff, site plan, vendor / insurance collection, production review, final guest count, final walkthrough, load-in confirmation, show day, load-out and closeout.

7. Document control

This working packet is not a permit drawing, survey, fire plan or guarantee of technical capacity. Event-specific approvals and the executed agreement control where they differ from general planning material.

Hawaiʻi Island venue and production grounds for concerts, EDM events, festivals, retreats, production rentals and other large-format experiences.
